# viettelcloud_vpc (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud VPC by ID, name, CIDR, or region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup VPC by ID
data "viettelcloud_vpc" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup VPC by Name
data "viettelcloud_vpc" "by_name" {
  name = "my-vpc"
}

# Lookup VPC by CIDR and Region Name
data "viettelcloud_vpc" "by_cidr_and_region" {
  cidr   = "10.0.0.0/16"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 network CIDR to filter by, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16.
- `id` (String) VPC ID (UUID). Exactly one VPC must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC to filter by.
- `region` (String) Project region name where the VPC resides to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VPC was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description of the VPC.
- `display_name` (String) Display name assigned by the platform.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the VPC was last updated (RFC3339).
